item.title: Jack Dorsey cuts nearly half of Block workforce amid major AI overhaul
item.description: Block announces massive layoffs affecting over 4,000 jobs as the payments company pivots to AI-driven operations under CEO Jack Dorsey's leadership.

item.title: Burger King makes changes to signature Whopper for first time in nearly a decade
item.description: Burger King announces its first Whopper update in nearly a decade, featuring a premium bun, better tasting mayo and new box packaging while keeping the same beef patty.

item.title: State Farm announces refund for car insurance customers
item.description: State Farm Mutual announced it will distribute $5 billion dividend to customers across 49 million vehicles due to lower collision rates and reduced auto repair costs.

item.title: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick makes quiet trip to India days after tariff setback
item.description: U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick visited India days after the Supreme Court struck down President Trump’s tariffs as New Delhi hints at revisiting its U.S. trade deal.

item.title: Blue state loses over 180,000 residents in past 5 years as high taxes weigh
item.description: Massachusetts lost about 182,000 residents to domestic out-migration from April 2020 to July 2025, according to a Pioneer Institute analysis of the state's labor force.

item.title: America's 10 most expensive ZIP codes revealed
item.description: A new Realtor.com analysis reveals the 10 priciest U.S. ZIP codes nationwide, from Newport Coast's $12.5 million median to Paradise Valley's $5.5 million entry point.

item.title: OpenAI reaches Pentagon agreement as Trump orders Anthropic off federal systems
item.description: OpenAI strikes Pentagon AI deal hours after President Trump orders federal agencies to phase out rival Anthropic over military AI safety concerns and policies.

item.title: Kevin O'Leary warns Gen Z: Bring your parents to an interview, resume goes 'right into the garbage'
item.description: Gen Z job seekers reportedly bringing parents to interviews shocks "Shark Tank" star Kevin O'Leary, who calls it a "horrific signal" to employers.

item.title: Oil markets on edge as Iran moves to restrict vital Strait of Hormuz shipping lane, report says
item.description: Iran is reportedly restricting navigation through the Strait of Hormuz after major U.S. and Israeli strikes, possibly threatening the global oil supply.

item.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman answers questions on new Pentagon deal: 'This technology is super important'
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman defends Pentagon AI deal as Trump orders federal agencies to cut ties with rival Anthropic over military surveillance concerns.
